events.text:
The level is won: all three heroes stand on doors (thief at (5,1), wizard at (7,1), warrior at (10,2)), confirmed by the rules tool.

The idea is that the warrior can only reach the door at (10,2) through the gate at (10,4), which opens only while all three plates are held. The crystal is trapped in the top-left room, so the wizard has to swap it out onto a plate, and the warrior then shoves it along the bottom row to its own plate.

Plan in outline:
1. The wizard goes to plate (2,6), the warrior to plate (10,6), and the thief to plate (6,6). Both gates open.
2. The wizard swaps with the crystal, which lands on plate (2,6). The wizard is now stuck in the top-left room.
3. The thief steps off (6,6) and the warrior walks around to the west end of the bottom row. It pushes the crystal east onto plate (6,6).
4. The warrior returns to (2,6) so the wizard can swap out of the room; the warrior then walks out and around to (10,5) and up through the gate to its door.
5. The wizard swaps with the crystal once more to get to its door, and the thief walks back to (5,1).
